results.trackName: The Kissing Part (Happy Endings in Clover Park, Book 1)
results.description:
The Kissing Part is book #1 in the new Happy Endings in Clover Park series by USA Today Bestseller Kylie Gilmore. Dive into feel-good small town romance in Clover Park, where everyone gets lucky!

What does a girl have to do to get a second chance with her first love?

Shayla
With a stalker following me cross-country, I’m officially on the A-list of actors, so when my bodyguard quit, the first person I thought of was security expert Owen Campbell. He’s the only man I’ve ever loved.

Nine years ago, he asked me to marry him, and I never answered. We were too young.

Owen, this is our second chance.

Owen
The moment I see Shayla Adler for the first time in years, everything in me shouts no. There’s a reason I’m a die-hard bachelor.

Except Shayla wants to hire me to deal with a determined stalker. One look at Shayla’s vulnerable eyes brings out all my protective instincts. I’ll do anything to keep her safe. In a strictly professional capacity.

The Happy Endings in Clover Park series
The Kissing Part (Book 1)
The Sexy Part (Book 2)
The Sweet Part (Book 3)
